title: Canon Memories
subtitle: Woven from a Saint's blood
text: Four manipulations have no living teacher. Each is a Canon Memory, woven from a Saint's blood. Fill a Consecrated Syringe at a sarcophagus by drawing from the corpus with empty Blood Vials, then process the syringe in a Vial Centrifuge for Hallowed Residuum. A Saint driven back into its tomb gives up Residuum directly. At the Somatic Loom the Residuum is one catalyst and the Saint's Recollection the other, with one enzyme of each of the Saint's two tendencies. The Gardens keep each Recollection in a cyst in their Archive, where only the eighth degree can draw it out. A Saint forced through a shattered ring door leaves only a fragment of Residuum; three make a whole. These are SUMMA-rank manipulations of tremendous cost. Crimson Tithe (Animus, Ferric) borrows blood against Hemorath's hunger and collects double what you spend. Unclosing Eye (Lux, Ductilis) strips concealment with Seraphae's sight. Bloom of Rot (Mortem, Flammeus) erupts Putriciel's rot through every body nearby, yours included. Endless Hour (Congeatio, Tenebris) holds a killing blow off for ten still seconds, then Velorum collects it. They are not given freely.
